issue.title: stats::completion_includes_worked and other unpinned __complete CLI tests run on the 150 ms production deadline and flake under suite load
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-gb.3 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, agent bob-cli-gb.3--1); triaged by the bob-cli-gb land agent.

Observation: `just check` monitor ksba7ad30wkf (2026-11-03T00:30Z, ToolRun 80779ac2b9b82c826106b514784b9bf0) failed three completion nodes under full parallel `cargo test --workspace` load: `articles::article_note_completion_shows_section_count` (already bob-cli-f2), `completion::vault::deadline_override_keeps_working` (recorded on active epic bob-cli-3j, which added it), and `stats::completion_includes_worked` (tests/cli/stats.rs:284 assert_success, empty stdout). The phase agent stashed its work and reran on the clean base: the same completion failures recurred, varying 2–3 per run. The failures passed in isolation and on rerun. Fail rate is unmeasured; the failures have not reproduced serially.

Root cause (source audit at 05e355ee): `completion_includes_worked` builds `bob __complete zsh --protocol 1 -- bob stats show ""` from `bob_command()`, not `bob_completion_command()` (tests/cli/support.rs), so it runs on the 150 ms production COMPLETE_DEADLINE_MS and returns nothing when the deadline is missed under suite load. A sweep finds the same unpinned pattern (`"__complete"` built on `bob_command()` without BOB_COMPLETE_DEADLINE_MS) in tests/cli/stats.rs, tests/cli/stats_clock.rs, tests/cli/capture/complete_task_complete.rs, tests/cli/capture/complete_wikilink_task.rs, tests/cli/capture/complete_relationship_owner.rs, tests/cli/capture/task_goto.rs, and tests/cli/help.rs (articles.rs is bob-cli-f2; capture/complete_themes.rs is bob-cli-g8).

Fix: route each of those completion invocations through `bob_completion_command()`, leave the production default unchanged, then run each module in isolation and under `just check`. The fix is not attributable to bob-cli-gb's clock work, which never touched these helpers.

Same unpinned completion-deadline omission in tests/cli/capture/complete_themes.rs
Check which triage steps landed after timeout

evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-go.11 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, 2026-11-04); triaged by bob-cli-go.land. During go.11's full parallel suite on its transfer-assist tree, stats::completion_includes_worked and stats_clock::completion_lists_only_canonical_clock_values_with_descriptions each failed once and passed immediately alone on the same tree; neither touches transfer code. Matches this bead's unpinned 150 ms __complete deadline root cause (tests/cli/stats.rs and tests/cli/stats_clock.rs are both in the sweep list).
